# HEM v0.7.4b6 — Activity on the relevant sensor readings

- Applies device activity to the relevant measurement's existing icon colour and information bubble throughout the room overview and expanded readings. Activity does not add visible text labels, badges or controls to the measurements, and measurement values and average markers retain their existing colours.
- Uses the same resolved fan purpose as HEM's backend, including Automatic roles derived from an exact purifier/extractor assignment or unambiguous selected room sensors. Particle filtration is associated with particulate readings; CO₂ and gas readings only show relevant ventilation activity.
- Shows moisture, thermal and ventilation activity as related context in the mold reading's bubble. This describes what equipment reports doing and does not claim mold removal or a measured reduction in risk. Unrelated light, noise and pressure readings stay neutral.
- Distinguishes reported heating, cooling, humidifying, dehumidifying, preheating, defrosting and air treatment. Idle, unavailable or missing activity reports do not become active merely because a device is enabled. Conflicting native reports and an off upstream supply are explained in the relevant bubble.
- Keeps the second air-quality reading available in expanded rooms on narrow screens when the compact header hides it. Activity also appears on additional relevant readings in the expanded view.
- Refreshes activity when native device attributes or upstream supply states change, including controllers recovered from the saved dashboard inventory while their Home Assistant facade is unavailable.
- Adds regression coverage for evidence precedence, automatic fan roles, expanded readings, native-only updates and mobile layouts. This update changes display evidence only; device commands, PID control and physical operating limits retain their existing behaviour.

Update through HACS with beta versions enabled, restart Home Assistant to load the integration, and reload the dashboard.
